facts.fact: 楔形文字是世界上最早的书写系统，存世的泥板记录自约公元前 3000 年至约公元 100 年；美索不达米亚的文化统治力由此而来。
facts.anchor: The cultural dominance of ancient Mesopotamia has a lot to do with Mesopotamians’ development of the first writing system in the world—cuneiform—which survives today on clay tablets that date from about 3000 BCE to about 100 CE.

facts.fact: 拉玛什图的年龄至少五千年，与文字本身同龄；针对她的咒文比马尔杜克的单神教化还要早数百年。
facts.anchor: In fact, Lamashtu is probably at least five thousand years old—which is to say, she’s approximately as old as writing itself.

facts.fact: 本章核心论断：这是一个把「因言论触犯父权而被恶魔化的女神」写成起源神话的故事——拉玛什图因此既是让女性害怕生育的机制，也是让女性害怕对父权发声不敢言的机制。
facts.anchor: This is an origin myth in which a female deity is literally demonized for speaking out in a way that offended Patriarchy.

facts.fact: 阿努本可杀死或囚禁女儿拉玛什图，却把她放逐到人间，等于「父权制造了她，父权把她放出到世上」；她是男性神祇制造的怪物。
facts.anchor: Patriarchy made her; Patriarchy sicced her on the world of human women, children, babies, and fetuses.

facts.fact: 《恩玛·艾利什》约成于公元前 1100 年，写在七块泥板上；它记述了马尔杜克崛起为最高父权的过程，并在近两千年间于新年节庆年年演出。
facts.anchor: Over a thousand years after the earliest incantations to Lamashtu, probably somewhere around the year 1100 BCE, Mesopotamian culture produced an epic poem on a set of seven clay tablets.

facts.fact: 马尔杜克用风灌满提亚马特的腹部、再以箭射穿她，象征意义上是把提亚马特强暴至死：这一举同时压制了她的生育力与声音。
facts.anchor: Symbolically, then, Marduk rapes Tiamat to death.

facts.fact: 咒文自述拉玛什图的三重出身：阿努生她、埃亚教养她、恩利尔给她安上兽脸——三尊男性神祇共同造成了她的怪物性。
facts.anchor: Anu created her, Ea educated her, and Enlil allotted her the face of a bitch.

facts.fact: 全书收束：这只怪物最持久的三项特征是性欲、生育暴力或杀婴、以及施法与以声音搅乱他人——正对应今天女性政治地位的三个战场。
facts.anchor: And in almost all cases, the three most persistent traits of this Monstrous Bitch are hypersexuality, reproductive violence or infanticide, and spellcasting or the destabilizing use of voice.
